extraction.name: NWPU-RESISC45
extraction.description: A large-scale benchmark dataset for remote sensing image scene classification
extraction.creator: Gong Cheng, Junwei Han, and Xiaoqiang Lu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected from Google Earth (Google Inc.) that maps the Earth by the superimposition of images obtained from satellite imagery, aerial photography and geographic information system (GIS) onto a 3D globe.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset contains 31,500 remote sensing images divided into 45 scene classes. Each class includes 700 images with a size of 256×256 pixels in the red green blue (RGB) color space.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The creation of this dataset was performed by experts in the field of remote sensing image interpretation.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The creation of this dataset will enable the community to develop and evaluate various new data-driven algorithms, at a much larger scale, to further improve the state-of-the-arts.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Almost all existing datasets have a number of limitations, such as the small scale of scene classes and images per class, the lack of image variations and diversity, and the saturation of accuracy.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Scene classification, Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning
